BiblicalUsage: A lamentation is a song taken up over a ruin. Micah says that in that day one shall take up a parable against the people and lament with a doleful lamentation — we are utterly spoiled, our portion is changed, our fields divided.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that lamentation is honest prayer: the people name the spoil plainly, and God lets the grief be spoken.
